items.title: European Stocks Fall as China Woes Hit Volvo Car, Gucci
items.description: European stocks fell for a second day as disappointing earnings, including from Kering SA’s Gucci, added to concerns over the artificial intelligence trade and elevated oil prices.

items.title: Hermès, Cartier’s Last Reliable Shoppers Are Retreating in China
items.description: Luxury powerhouses including Hermès and Cartier are suffering steeper slumps in China, in a sign that a spending pullback by the country’s wealthy consumers is hitting even the most resilient brands.

items.title: Margin Trade Liquidation Speeds Indian Small-Cap Stock Decline
items.description: A wave of deleveraging by retail investors has triggered the biggest rout in Indian small-cap stocks in seven months, as mounting concerns over inflation and higher interest rates weigh on sentiment.

items.title: China Offshore Yuan Bonds Priced at Record Lows Amid Rally
items.description: China sold government bonds in Hong Kong at record-low yields for most maturities, as offshore yields tracked a rally in the onshore debt market.

items.title: Eni Raises Payouts as High Fuel Prices Bolster Cash Flow
items.description: Eni SpA said it will return more cash to shareholders after the Middle East war drove up energy prices and sent refining margins soaring.

items.title: Volvo Profit Rises on Truck Demand in North America, Europe
items.description: Volvo AB said improving demand in North America and Europe helped deliver solid earnings in the third quarter with the truckmaker planning to gradually increase production.

items.title: Holcim Lifts Guidance Again Driven by Strong Demand
items.description: Holcim Ltd. raised its full-year guidance for the second time this year after robust demand for more sustainable building materials saw third-quarter profit beat expectations.

items.title: Copper Pares Weekly Decline as Selloff in AI Stocks Eases
items.description: Copper pared a third weekly loss in four as a selloff in technology stocks eased, mitigating concerns about demand for the metal that’s used in data centers and power infrastructure.

items.title: China Stocks Rebound as National Team ETF Buying Picks Up
items.description: Chinese stocks swung into gains as turnover in a basket of exchange-traded funds favored by the national team picked up pace.

items.title: South Korean Stocks Reverse Early Drop as Chipmakers Rebound
items.description: South Korean stocks reversed course to end higher on Friday as heavyweight chipmakers rebounded, underscoring investors’ continued conviction in the AI trade.

items.title: Tech Rout Eases With Oil Strength Capping Relief: Markets Wrap
items.description: A rout in the artificial intelligence trade faded, offering global stock investors some respite in the final session of a volatile week, with further gains in oil prices keeping sentiment cautious.

items.title: Rapid Junk Rout Swells Arini’s Losses, Erases Sona’s Gains
items.description: Arini Capital Management and Sona Asset Management’s main hedge funds were pummeled in recent weeks, as a sharp decline in pockets of the junk-debt market slammed their holdings.
